direction: Inspired by prefecture and city conquest strategy games with round battle units and bright tabletop-style territorial warfare.
selected_concept: Nationwide node-link conquest across prefectures and major cities with auto-growing forces, visible front-line streams, and supply-cut tactics.
visual_differentiation_axes: bright atlas-board UI instead of neon conquest styling
left tactical rail and bottom node card instead of bottom-wide command strip
round commander icon silhouette over a map-pin crest
route ribbons and stamp motifs as recurring screen language
forbidden_visual_reuse: no repeated top-pill chain plus bottom bar HUD
no generic castle or sword icon subject
no overlays placed over contested node clusters

ui_identity.layout_archetype: corner command cards with left tactical rail and unobstructed central atlas
ui_identity.hud_composition: upper-left objective card upper-right utility controls left-edge commander rail lower-left node card lower-right mode controls
ui_identity.navigation_model: chapter region map with stage nodes medals and codex side paths
ui_identity.palette_signature: sky blue cream paper red faction accents gold stamps and ink-blue labels
ui_identity.material_language: travel atlas paper cards polished enamel chips route ribbons and stamp seals
ui_identity.typography_style: rounded poster-like sans with bold compact numerals

playfield_safety.frame_overlay_policy: all ornamental map framing must remain outside the protected route mesh and use structural gutters instead of live overlays

icon_identity.subject: round prefecture atlas ticket token over regional map pin
icon_identity.silhouette: large circle face over a regional map pin with atlas ticket accent
icon_identity.composition: foreground prefecture token breaking out of a regional map pin with atlas ticket accent and trailing route streaks
icon_identity.palette: sky blue warm red cream white gold accents
icon_identity.background: soft paper-map burst with faint route lines
icon_identity.game_specific_motif: prefecture conquest route streak and command baton
forbidden_icon_reuse: no reused shield badge from another war game
